description: Deliver the AWS-dependent production pieces as source + IaC + a precise, executable-by-an-operator runbook — NOT executed and NOT faked. These are BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT (no AWS credentials in the sandbox; a chat-pasted key must never be used). Covers: the wecare-checkout function, the /ecommerce/* HTTP API routes and their IAM, the S3 bag-icon upload + CDN URL, the pre-deploy alias checkpoint across the ~60 Lambdas, and the eventual authorized cancel-only live monetary test to +918100640044. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create a single runbook doc at docs/execution/website-checkout-provisioning-runbook-2026-10-01.md. Open with a BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT banner: no AWS credentials present (aws sts get-caller-identity fails), WAF/Security Hub out of scope, never read/print secret values, never call secretsmanager get-secret-value, use {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}} references only, any Cognito change goes through scripts/cognito_pool_safe_update.py, single-branch 'stack' git workflow, orchestrator pushes.

Section 1 — wecare-checkout function + /ecommerce/* routes + IAM. Reference the existing scripts/provision_checkout.py (FUNCTION_DIR = amplify/functions/ecommerce/checkout) and scripts/deploy_all_lambdas.py (the checkout Lambda is already listed). Write the exact ordered commands an operator runs under profile wecare-prod / account 775261844268 / us-east-1: rediscover the current HTTP API id (do NOT reuse a stale id) via aws apigatewayv2 get-apis; create/verify the function; add the /ecommerce/* routes (prepare-checkout and verify-callback endpoints the website_checkout path expects) with their integrations; attach the least-privilege IAM policy (DynamoDB commerce-keys + invoices tables, secretsmanager GetSecretValue scoped to wecare/razorpay/api by ARN via resource policy, no wildcard). Include the exact verification reads (get-function, get-alias live, get-routes) and the rollback (update-alias to the prior version). State the environment variables to set, INCLUDING that CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED stays unset/false and the readiness inputs (EXPECTED_CONFIGURATION_NAME/EXPECTED_PROVIDER_MID) remain empty so the gate stays DISABLED.

Section 2 — S3 bag-icon upload + CDN URL. Document the exact aws s3 cp (or put-object) command to upload the bag icon to the secure/public media prefix the frontend references, the resulting CloudFront/CDN URL pattern, and how to verify via a HEAD request. Reference media_paths helpers for the correct prefix. Do not upload here (no credentials); provide the command and the expected URL only.

Section 3 — pre-deploy alias checkpoint across ~60 Lambdas. Document the exact procedure to snapshot every function's current live alias target version BEFORE any deploy (a loop over list-functions → get-alias live → record function:version), store the checkpoint to a dated file, and the one-command rollback to restore each alias if a deploy regresses. Emphasize UpdateUserPool / alias safety and that this is the recorded-incident mitigation.

Section 4 — authorized cancel-only live monetary test to +918100640044. Document the exact minimal steps for an authorized operator to run a cancel-only (no settled charge) live verification against the real provider once credentials and owner authorization are present: create the smallest gateway order, drive the website callback, then CANCEL/refund so no money is captured/retained, and the exact reads to confirm no settled payment remains. Mark explicitly that this must NEVER be executed by the agent and only by an authorized human with owner sign-off; it is reported BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT.

For every section, include an 'Unblock actions' subsection naming exactly what must arrive (sandbox-provided AWS credentials via environment not chat, owner authorization for the live test, Wix publication) and the precise command to confirm the blocker is cleared (aws sts get-caller-identity succeeding, etc.).
Do NOT run any aws/boto/network-mutating command. Do NOT fabricate any live result. Record in findings that all of Section 1-4 are BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT and delivered as runbook only.
acceptance_criteria: docs/execution/website-checkout-provisioning-runbook-2026-10-01.md exists with the BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT banner and all four sections, each with exact commands, verification reads, rollback, and unblock actions
The runbook keeps the initiation gate DISABLED (no step enables CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED or sets forcing env vars) and uses {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}} references, never get-secret-value
No AWS/network command was executed; no live result is fabricated; findings records everything as BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT
The cancel-only live monetary test to +918100640044 is documented as human-operator-only with owner sign-off, never agent-executed

It opens with a BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT banner and the four required sections (1: wecare-checkout function + /ecommerce/prepare-checkout and /ecommerce/verify-callback routes + least-privilege IAM, driving scripts/provision_checkout.py --dry-run/apply/--verify and rediscovering the HTTP API id via apigatewayv2 get-apis; 2: S3 bag-icon upload to the public o/ prefix per media_paths.py with the wecare.digital/get CDN URL and HEAD verification; 3: pre-deploy live-alias checkpoint across the ~60 Lambdas with one-command rollback and post_deploy_health.py; 4: human-operator-only, owner-sign-off cancel-only live test to +918100640044). Each section has ordered commands, verification reads, rollback and an Unblock actions subsection. The initiation gate stays DISABLED (no step sets CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED; EXPECTED_CONFIGURATION_NAME/EXPECTED_PROVIDER_MID remain empty). Grounded in real scripts: provision_checkout.py, deploy_all_lambdas.py (wecare-checkout entry), provision_live_alias.py, post_deploy_health.py, cognito_pool_safe_update.py, media_paths.py, website_checkout.py.
